<p id="mwAbc">The backup crew consisted of Lovell as Commander, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Anders" title="William Anders" id="mwAbg">William Anders</a> as CMP, and Haise as LMP. Anders had flown with Lovell on Apollo<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAbk">&nbsp;</span>8.<sup about="#mwt248" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff200090_51-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEOrloff200090&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff200090-51&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Orloff&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;90&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff200090-51" id="mwAbo"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAbs"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAbw">[</span>51<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAb0">]</span></span></a></sup> In early 1969, Anders accepted a job with the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Space_Council" title="National Space Council" id="mwAb4">National Aeronautics and Space Council</a> effective August 1969, and announced he would retire as an astronaut at that time. <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ken_Mattingly" title="Ken Mattingly" id="mwAb8">Ken Mattingly</a> was moved from the support crew into parallel training with Anders as backup CMP in case Apollo 11 was delayed past its intended July launch date, at which point Anders would be unavailable.<sup about="#mwt251" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237_56-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237-56&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Slayton&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Cassutt&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;237&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237-56" id="mwAcA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAcE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAcI">[</span>56<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAcM">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwAcQ">Under the normal Apollo crew rotation, Lovell, Mattingly, and Haise would have been assigned to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_14" title="Apollo 14" id="mwAcU">Apollo 14</a>. However, because <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alan_Shepard" title="Alan Shepard" id="mwAcY">Alan Shepard</a> had only recently returned to flight status and needed additional training, NASA reassigned his crew to Apollo 14 and moved Lovell's crew up to fly <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_13" title="Apollo 13" id="mwAcc">Apollo 13</a> instead.<sup about="#mwt254" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-58" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;lower-alpha&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-58&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;efn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Efn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;The role of the backup crew was to train and be prepared to fly in the event something happened to the prime crew.&lt;ref&gt;{{Cite web |date=January 30, 2019 |title=50 years ago, NASA names Apollo 11 crew |url=https://www.nasa.gov/feature/50-years-ago-nasa-names-apollo-11-crew |access-date=February 24, 2023 |publisher=NASA}}&lt;/ref&gt; Backup crews, according to the rotation, were assigned as the prime crew three missions after their assignment of backups.&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-58" data-mw-group="lower-alpha" id="mwAcg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAck"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAco">[</span>a<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAcs">]</span></span></a></sup> Shortly before launch, Mattingly was replaced by <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_Swigert" title="Jack Swigert" id="mwAcw">Jack Swigert</a> due to concerns over possible measles exposure.<sup about="#mwt264" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237_56-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237-56&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Slayton&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Cassutt&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;237&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994237-56" id="mwAc0"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAc4"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAc8">[</span>56<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAdA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="5" id="mwAdE" aria-labelledby="Support_crew"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Support_crew">Support crew</h3></div>

<p id="mwAdI">During Projects Mercury and Gemini, each mission had a prime and a backup crew. For Apollo, NASA added a third group, the support crew. Their job was to maintain the flight plan, checklists, and mission rules, and to keep the prime and backup crews updated on any changes. They also developed procedures—especially for emergencies, so that by the time the prime and backup crews entered the simulators, they could focus on practicing and mastering them.<sup about="#mwt267" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979261_59-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979261&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979261-59&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Brooks&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Grimwood&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Swenson&quot;},&quot;4&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1979&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;261&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979261-59" id="mwAdM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAdQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAdU">[</span>58<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAdY">]</span></span></a></sup> The support crew for Apollo 11 was Mattingly, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronald_Evans_(astronaut)" title="Ronald Evans (astronaut)" id="mwAdc">Ronald Evans</a>, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_R._Pogue" title="William R. Pogue" class="mw-redirect" id="mwAdg">Bill Pogue</a>.<sup about="#mwt270" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375_60-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375-60&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Brooks&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Grimwood&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Swenson&quot;},&quot;4&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1979&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;375&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375-60" id="mwAdk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAdo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAds">[</span>59<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAdw">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="6" id="mwAd0" aria-labelledby="Capsule_communicators"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Capsule_communicators">Capsule communicators</h3></div>

<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwAd4"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Duke,_Lovell_and_Haise_at_the_Apollo_11_Capcom,_Johnson_Space_Center,_Houston,_Texas_-_19690720.jpg" class="mw-file-description" id="mwAd8"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Duke,_Lovell_and_Haise_at_the_Apollo_11_Capcom,_Johnson_Space_Center,_Houston,_Texas_-_19690720.jpg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5d/Duke%2C_Lovell_and_Haise_at_the_Apollo_11_Capcom%2C_Johnson_Space_Center%2C_Houston%2C_Texas_-_19690720.jpg/250px-Duke%2C_Lovell_and_Haise_at_the_Apollo_11_Capcom%2C_Johnson_Space_Center%2C_Houston%2C_Texas_-_19690720.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5d/Duke%2C_Lovell_and_Haise_at_the_Apollo_11_Capcom%2C_Johnson_Space_Center%2C_Houston%2C_Texas_-_19690720.jpg/500px-Duke%2C_Lovell_and_Haise_at_the_Apollo_11_Capcom%2C_Johnson_Space_Center%2C_Houston%2C_Texas_-_19690720.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="4132" data-file-height="2784" data-file-type="bitmap" height="168" width="250" class="mw-file-element" id="mwAeA"></a><figcaption id="mwAeE">CAPCOM <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Duke" title="Charles Duke" id="mwAeI">Charles Duke</a> (left), with backup crewmembers Lovell and Haise listening in during Apollo 11's descent</figcaption></figure>

<p id="mwAeM">The <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capsule_communicator" title="Capsule communicator" class="mw-redirect" id="mwAeQ">capsule communicator</a> (CAPCOM) was an astronaut stationed at the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christopher_C._Kraft_Jr._Mission_Control_Center" title="Christopher C. Kraft Jr. Mission Control Center" id="mwAeU">Mission Control Center</a> in <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Houston" title="Houston" id="mwAeY">Houston</a>, Texas, and was typically the only person permitted to communicate directly with the flight crew.<sup about="#mwt273" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEKranz200027_61-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEKranz200027&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEKranz200027-61&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Kranz&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;27&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKranz200027-61" id="mwAec"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAeg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAek">[</span>60<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAeo">]</span></span></a></sup> This practice ensured that messages came from someone best able to understand the situation in the spacecraft and to relay guidance from <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flight_controller" title="Flight controller" id="mwAes">flight controllers</a> as clearly as possible. For Apollo 11, the CAPCOMs were backup and support crew members Anders, Evans, Haise, Lovell, and Mattingly, along with <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Duke" title="Charles Duke" id="mwAew">Charles Duke</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Owen_Garriott" title="Owen Garriott" id="mwAe0">Owen Garriott</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don_L._Lind" title="Don L. Lind" class="mw-redirect" id="mwAe4">Don L. Lind</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bruce_McCandless_II" title="Bruce McCandless II" id="mwAe8">Bruce McCandless II</a>, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrison_Schmitt" title="Harrison Schmitt" id="mwAfA">Harrison Schmitt</a>.<sup about="#mwt276" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375_60-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375-60&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Brooks&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Grimwood&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Swenson&quot;},&quot;4&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1979&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;375&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979375-60" id="mwAfE"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAfI"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAfM">[</span>59<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAfQ">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="7" id="mwAfU" aria-labelledby="Flight_directors"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Flight_directors">Flight directors</h3></div>

<p id="mwAfY">The <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flight_controller#FLIGHT" title="Flight controller" id="mwAfc">flight directors</a> for this mission were:<sup about="#mwt279" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000272_62-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEOrloff2000272&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000272-62&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Orloff&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;272&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000272-62" id="mwAfg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAfk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAfo">[</span>61<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAfs">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt282" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEKranz2000230,_236,_273,_320_63-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEKranz2000230, 236, 273, 320&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEKranz2000230,_236,_273,_320-63&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Kranz&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;230, 236, 273, 320&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKranz2000230,_236,_273,_320-63" id="mwAfw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAf0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAf4">[</span>62<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAf8">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt287" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-NASA-SP4223_64-0" rel="dc:references" </section></section><section data-mw-section-id="9" id="mwAnc" aria-labelledby="Preparations"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Preparations">Preparations</h2></div>
<section data-mw-section-id="10" id="mwAng" aria-labelledby="Insignia"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Insignia">Insignia</h3></div>

<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwAnk"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_insignia.png" class="mw-file-description" id="mwAno"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_insignia.png" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/27/Apollo_11_insignia.png/250px-Apollo_11_insignia.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/27/Apollo_11_insignia.png/500px-Apollo_11_insignia.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="5380" data-file-height="5432" data-file-type="bitmap" height="252" width="250" class="mw-file-element" id="mwAns"></a><figcaption id="mwAnw">The Apollo 11 insignia. The eagle is carrying an olive branch to represent a peaceful mission</figcaption></figure>

<p id="mwAn0">The Apollo 11 <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mission_patch" title="Mission patch" id="mwAn4">mission emblem</a> was designed by Collins, who wanted a symbol for "peaceful lunar landing by the United States". At Lovell's suggestion, he chose the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bald_eagle" title="Bald eagle" id="mwAn8">bald eagle</a>, the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_bird" title="National bird" class="mw-redirect" id="mwAoA">national bird</a> of the United States, as the symbol. Tom Wilson, a simulator instructor, suggested an <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olive_branch" title="Olive branch" id="mwAoE">olive branch</a> in its beak to represent their peaceful mission. Collins added a lunar background with the Earth in the distance. The sunlight in the image was coming from the wrong direction; the shadow should have been in the lower part of the Earth instead of the left.<sup about="#mwt300" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334_69-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334-69&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;332–334&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334-69" id="mwAoI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAoM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAoQ">[</span>68<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAoU">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwAoY">Aldrin, Armstrong and Collins decided the Eagle and the Moon would be in their natural colors, and decided on a blue and gold border. Armstrong was concerned that "eleven" would not be understood by non-English speakers, so they went with "Apollo 11",<sup about="#mwt303" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334_69-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334-69&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;332–334&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334-69" id="mwAoc"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAog"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAok">[</span>68<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAoo">]</span></span></a></sup> and they decided not to put their names on the patch, so it would "be representative of <i id="mwAos">everyone</i> who had worked toward a lunar landing".<sup about="#mwt306" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001332_70-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001332&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332-70&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;332&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332-70" id="mwAow"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAo0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAo4">[</span>69<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAo8">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwApA">An illustrator at the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manned_Spacecraft_Center" title="Manned Spacecraft Center" class="mw-redirect" id="mwApE">Manned Spacecraft Center</a> (MSC) did the artwork, which was then sent off to NASA officials for approval.<sup about="#mwt309" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334_69-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334-69&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;332–334&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001332–334-69" id="mwApI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwApM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwApQ">[</span>68<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwApU">]</span></span></a></sup> The design was rejected. <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Gilruth" title="Bob Gilruth" class="mw-redirect" id="mwApY">Bob Gilruth</a>, the director of the MSC felt the talons of the eagle looked "too warlike".<sup about="#mwt312" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001333_71-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001333&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001333-71&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;333&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001333-71" id="mwApc"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwApg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwApk">[</span>70<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwApo">]</span></span></a></sup> After some discussion, the olive branch was moved to the talons.<sup about="#mwt315" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001333_71-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001333&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001333-71&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;333&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001333-71" id="mwAps"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwApw"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAp0">[</span>70<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAp4">]</span></span></a></sup> When the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eisenhower_dollar" title="Eisenhower dollar" id="mwAp8">Eisenhower dollar coin</a> was released in 1971, the patch design provided the eagle for its reverse side.<sup about="#mwt320" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-72" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-72&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-72" id="mwAqA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAqE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAqI">[</span>71<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAqM">]</span></span></a></sup> The design was also used for the smaller <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Susan_B._Anthony_dollar" title="Susan B. Anthony dollar" id="mwAqQ">Susan B. Anthony dollar</a> unveiled in 1979.<sup about="#mwt323" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-73" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-73&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-73" id="mwAqU"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAqY"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAqc">[</span>72<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAqg">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="11" id="mwAqk" aria-labelledby="Call_signs"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Call_signs">Call signs</h3></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwAqo"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:NASM-NASM2013-02663.jpg" class="mw-file-description" id="mwAqs"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:NASM-NASM2013-02663.jpg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/dc/NASM-NASM2013-02663.jpg/250px-NASM-NASM2013-02663.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/dc/NASM-NASM2013-02663.jpg/500px-NASM-NASM2013-02663.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="12000" data-file-height="9000" data-file-type="bitmap" height="188" width="250" class="mw-file-element" id="mwAqw"></a><figcaption id="mwAq0">The original cockpit of the command module (CM) with three seats, photographed from above. It is located in the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Air_and_Space_Museum" title="National Air and Space Museum" id="mwAq4">National Air and Space Museum</a>. The very high resolution image was produced in 2007 by the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smithsonian_Institution" title="Smithsonian Institution" id="mwAq8">Smithsonian Institution</a>.</figcaption></figure>
<p id="mwArA">After the crew of Apollo 10 named their spacecraft <i id="mwArE">Charlie Brown</i> and <i id="mwArI">Snoopy</i>, assistant manager for public affairs <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_Scheer" title="Julian Scheer" id="mwArM">Julian Scheer</a> wrote to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Low" title="George Low" id="mwArQ">George Low</a>, the Manager of the Apollo Spacecraft Program Office at the MSC, to suggest the Apollo 11 crew be less flippant in naming their craft. The name <i id="mwArU">Snowcone</i> was used for the CM and <i id="mwArY">Haystack</i> was used for the LM in both internal and external communications during early mission planning.<sup about="#mwt324" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEMarshall_Space_Flight_Center19698_74-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEMarshall Space Flight Center19698&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEMarshall_Space_Flight_Center19698-74&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Marshall Space Flight Center&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1969&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;8&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMarshall_Space_Flight_Center19698-74" id="mwArc"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwArg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwArk">[</span>73<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAro">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwArs">The LM was named <i id="mwArw"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_Module_Eagle" title="Lunar Module Eagle" id="mwAr0">Eagle</a></i> after the motif which was featured prominently on the mission insignia. At Scheer's suggestion, the CM was named <i id="mwAr4"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Command_module_Columbia" title="Command module Columbia" id="mwAr8">Columbia</a></i> after <i id="mwAsA"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbiad#In_fiction" title="Columbiad" id="mwAsE">Columbiad</a></i>, the giant cannon that launched a spacecraft (also from Florida) in <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jules_Verne" title="Jules Verne" id="mwAsI">Jules Verne</a>'s 1865 novel <i id="mwAsM"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/From_the_Earth_to_the_Moon" title="From the Earth to the Moon" id="mwAsQ">From the Earth to the Moon</a></i>. It also referred to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbia_(name)" title="Columbia (name)" class="mw-redirect" id="mwAsU">Columbia</a>, a historical name of the United States.<sup about="#mwt327" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001334–335_75-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001334–335&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001334–335-75&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;334–335&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001334–335-75" id="mwAsY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAsc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAsg">[</span>74<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAsk">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt330" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979331_76-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979331&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979331-76&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Brooks&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Grimwood&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Swenson&quot;},&quot;4&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1979&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;331&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979331-76" id="mwAso"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAss"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAsw">[</span>75<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAs0">]</span></span></a></sup> In Collins' 1976 book, he said <i id="mwAs4">Columbia</i> was in reference to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christopher_Columbus" title="Christopher Columbus" id="mwAs8">Christopher Columbus</a>.<sup about="#mwt333" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins1994116_77-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins1994116&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins1994116-77&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;116&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins1994116-77" id="mwAtA"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAtE"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAtI">[</span>76<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAtM">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="12" id="mwAtQ" aria-labelledby="Mementos"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Mementos">Mementos</h3></div>

<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwAtU"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_Flown_Silver_Robbins_Medallion_(SN-416).jpg" class="mw-file-description" id="mwAtY"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_Flown_Silver_Robbins_Medallion_(SN-416).jpg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6f/Apollo_11_Flown_Silver_Robbins_Medallion_%28SN-416%29.jpg/250px-Apollo_11_Flown_Silver_Robbins_Medallion_%28SN-416%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6f/Apollo_11_Flown_Silver_Robbins_Medallion_%28SN-416%29.jpg/500px-Apollo_11_Flown_Silver_Robbins_Medallion_%28SN-416%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" alt="see caption" data-file-width="3654" data-file-height="1851" data-file-type="bitmap" height="127" width="250" class="mw-file-element" id="mwAtc"></a><figcaption id="mwAtg">Apollo 11 space-flown silver <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA_space-flown_Gemini_and_Apollo_medallions" title="NASA space-flown Gemini and Apollo medallions" id="mwAtk">Robbins medallion</a></figcaption></figure>

<p id="mwAto">The astronauts had <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Personal_preference_kit" title="Personal preference kit" id="mwAts">personal preference kits</a> (PPKs), small bags containing personal items of significance they wanted to take with them on the mission.<sup about="#mwt339" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-78" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-78&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-78" id="mwAtw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAt0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAt4">[</span>77<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAt8">]</span></span></a></sup> Five <span about="#mwt336" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwAuA" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;0.5&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;lb&quot;},&quot;adj&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;on&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">0.5-pound (0.23</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt336">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt336">kg)</span> PPKs were carried on Apollo 11: three (one for each astronaut) were stowed on <i id="mwAuE">Columbia</i> before launch, and two on <i id="mwAuI">Eagle</i>.<sup about="#mwt342" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-79" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-79&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-79" id="mwAuM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAuQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAuU">[</span>78<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAuY">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwAuc">Neil Armstrong's LM PPK contained a piece of wood from the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wright_brothers" title="Wright brothers" id="mwAug">Wright brothers</a>' 1903 <i id="mwAuk"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wright_Flyer" title="Wright Flyer" id="mwAuo">Wright Flyer</a></i><span class="nowrap" style="padding-left:0.1em;" about="#mwt343" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwAus" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;'&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:'&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><span typeof="mw:Entity">'</span></span>s left propeller and a piece of fabric from its wing,<sup about="#mwt344" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEHansen2005527_80-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEHansen2005527&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005527-80&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hansen &quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2005&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;527&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005527-80" id="mwAuw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAu0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAu4">[</span>79<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAu8">]</span></span></a></sup> along with a diamond-studded <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astronaut_pin" title="Astronaut pin" class="mw-redirect" id="mwAvA">astronaut pin</a> originally given to Slayton by the widows of the Apollo<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAvE">&nbsp;</span>1 crew. This pin had been intended to be flown on that mission and given to Slayton afterwards, but following the disastrous launch pad fire and subsequent funerals, the widows gave the pin to Slayton. Armstrong took it with him on Apollo 11.<sup about="#mwt347" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994191–192_81-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994191–192&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994191–192-81&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Slayton&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Cassutt&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;191–192&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTESlaytonCassutt1994191–192-81" id="mwAvI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAvM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAvQ">[</span>80<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAvU">]</span></span></a></sup></p>
