  top:  -4px;"><span typeof="mw:File" data-mw="{&quot;caption&quot;:&quot;&quot;}"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oceanus_Procellarum" title="Oceanus Procellarum"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:5_white,_blue_rounded_rectangle.svg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/ff/5_white%2C_blue_rounded_rectangle.svg/20px-5_white%2C_blue_rounded_rectangle.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" data-file-width="175" data-file-height="250" data-file-type="drawing" height="11" width="8" class="mw-file-element"></a></span></div><div style="position: relative; z-index: 4; font-size: 90%; line-height: 111%; width: 6em;
     top: -1.5em; left:  0.5em; text-align: left;"><span style="padding: 1px; "></span></div>
</div></div><div class="thumbcaption">A map of the Moon showing prospective landing sites for Apollo 11. Site 2 in the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mare_Tranquillitatis" title="Mare Tranquillitatis">Sea of Tranquility</a> was chosen.</div>
  </div>
</div>
<p id="mwAvs">NASA's Apollo Site Selection Board announced five potential landing sites on February 8, 1968. These were the result of two years' worth of studies based on high-resolution photography of the lunar surface by the five uncrewed probes of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_Orbiter_program" title="Lunar Orbiter program" id="mwAvw">Lunar Orbiter program</a> and information about surface conditions provided by the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveyor_program" title="Surveyor program" id="mwAv0">Surveyor program</a>.<sup about="#mwt360" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Site_Selection_82-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Site Selection&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Site_Selection-82&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Site_Selection-82" id="mwAv4"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAv8"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAwA">[</span>81<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAwE">]</span></span></a></sup> The best Earth-bound telescopes could not resolve features with the resolution Project Apollo required.<sup about="#mwt352" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECortright197579_83-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECortright197579&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECortright197579-83&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Cortright&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1975&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;79&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECortright197579-83" id="mwAwI"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAwM"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAwQ">[</span>82<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAwU">]</span></span></a></sup> The landing site had to be close to the lunar equator to minimize the amount of propellant required, clear of obstacles to minimize maneuvering, and flat to simplify the task of the landing radar. Scientific value was not a consideration.<sup about="#mwt355" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEHarland199919_84-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEHarland199919&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEHarland199919-84&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Harland&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1999&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;19&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHarland199919-84" id="mwAwY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAwc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAwg">[</span>83<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAwk">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwAwo">Areas that appeared promising on photographs taken on Earth were often found to be totally unacceptable. The original requirement that the site be free of craters had to be relaxed, as no such site was found.<sup about="#mwt361" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECortright197598–99_85-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECortright197598–99&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECortright197598–99-85&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Cortright&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1975&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;98–99&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECortright197598–99-85" id="mwAws"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAww"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAw0">[</span>84<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAw4">]</span></span></a></sup> Five sites were considered: Sites<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAw8">&nbsp;</span>1 and<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAxA">&nbsp;</span>2 were in the Sea of Tranquility (<i id="mwAxE"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mare_Tranquillitatis" title="Mare Tranquillitatis" id="mwAxI">Mare Tranquillitatis</a></i>); Site<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAxM">&nbsp;</span>3 was in the Central Bay (<span style="padding-right:0.15em;" about="#mwt364" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwAxQ" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;italics correction&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Italics_correction&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;''[[Sinus Medii]]''&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><i><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sinus_Medii" title="Sinus Medii">Sinus Medii</a></i></span>); and Sites<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAxU">&nbsp;</span>4 and<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAxY">&nbsp;</span>5 were in the Ocean of Storms (<i id="mwAxc"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oceanus_Procellarum" title="Oceanus Procellarum" id="mwAxg">Oceanus Procellarum</a></i>).<sup about="#mwt365" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Site_Selection_82-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Site Selection&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Site_Selection-82" id="mwAxk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAxo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAxs">[</span>81<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAxw">]</span></span></a></sup>
The final site selection was based on seven criteria:</p>
<ul id="mwAx0"><li id="mwAx4">The site needed to be smooth, with relatively few craters;</li>
<li id="mwAx8">with approach paths free of large hills, tall cliffs or deep craters that might confuse the landing radar and cause it to issue incorrect readings;</li>
<li id="mwAyA">reachable with a minimum amount of propellant;</li>
<li id="mwAyE">allowing for delays in the launch countdown;</li>
<li id="mwAyI">providing the Apollo spacecraft with a free-return trajectory, one that would allow it to coast around the Moon and safely return to Earth without requiring any engine firings should a problem arise on the way to the Moon;</li>
<li id="mwAyM">with good visibility during the landing approach, meaning the Sun would be between 7<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAyQ">&nbsp;</span>and 20 degrees behind the LM; and</li>
<li id="mwAyU">a general slope of less than two degrees in the landing area.<sup about="#mwt366" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Site_Selection_82-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Site Selection&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Site_Selection-82" id="mwAyY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAyc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAyg">[</span>81<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAyk">]</span></span></a></sup></li></ul>

<p id="mwAyo">The requirement for the Sun angle was particularly restrictive, limiting the launch date to one day per month.<sup about="#mwt374" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Site_Selection_82-3" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Site Selection&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Site_Selection-82" id="mwAys"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAyw"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAy0">[</span>81<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAy4">]</span></span></a></sup> A landing just after dawn was chosen to limit the temperature extremes the astronauts would experience.<sup about="#mwt367" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins19947_86-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins19947&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins19947-86&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;7&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins19947-86" id="mwAy8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAzA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAzE">[</span>85<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAzI">]</span></span></a></sup> The Apollo Site Selection Board selected Site<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAzM">&nbsp;</span>2, with Sites 3<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAzQ">&nbsp;</span>and<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAzU">&nbsp;</span>5 as backups in the event of the launch being delayed. In May 1969, Apollo 10's lunar module flew to within <span about="#mwt370" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwAzY" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;15&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;km&quot;},&quot;sp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;us&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">15 kilometers (9.3</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt370">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt370">mi)</span> of Site<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwAzc">&nbsp;</span>2, and reported it was acceptable.<sup about="#mwt371" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECappellari1972976_87-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECappellari1972976&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECappellari1972976-87&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Cappellari&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1972&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;976&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECappellari1972976-87" id="mwAzg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAzk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAzo">[</span>86<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAzs">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt377" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-88" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-88&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-88" id="mwAzw"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwAz0"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAz4">[</span>87<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwAz8">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="14" id="mwA0A" aria-labelledby="First-step_decision"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="First-step_decision">First-step decision</h3></div>
<p id="mwA0E">During the first press conference after the Apollo 11 crew was announced, the first question was, "Which one of you gentlemen will be the first man to step onto the lunar surface?"<sup about="#mwt378" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148_89-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148-89&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Chaikin&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;148&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148-89" id="mwA0I"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA0M"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA0Q">[</span>88<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA0U">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt381" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEHansen2005360_90-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEHansen2005360&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005360-90&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hansen&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2005&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;360&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005360-90" id="mwA0Y"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA0c"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA0g">[</span>89<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA0k">]</span></span></a></sup> Slayton told the reporter it had not been decided, and Armstrong added that it was "not based on individual desire".<sup about="#mwt384" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148_89-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148-89&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Chaikin&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;148&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994148-89" id="mwA0o"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA0s"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA0w">[</span>88<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA00">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwA04">One of the first versions of the egress checklist had the lunar module pilot exit the spacecraft before the commander, which matched what had been done on Gemini missions,<sup about="#mwt387" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001347_91-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001347&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001347-91&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;347&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001347-91" id="mwA08"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA1A"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA1E">[</span>90<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA1I">]</span></span></a></sup> where the commander had never performed the spacewalk.<sup about="#mwt390" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEAldrinAbraham201657–58_92-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEAldrinAbraham201657–58&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEAldrinAbraham201657–58-92&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Aldrin&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Abraham&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2016&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;57–58&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEAldrinAbraham201657–58-92" id="mwA1M"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA1Q"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA1U">[</span>91<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA1Y">]</span></span></a></sup> Reporters wrote in early 1969 that Aldrin would be the first man to walk on the Moon, and Associate Administrator <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Mueller_(NASA)" title="George Mueller (NASA)" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA1c">George Mueller</a> told reporters he would be first as well. Aldrin heard that Armstrong would be the first because Armstrong was a civilian, which made Aldrin livid. Aldrin attempted to persuade other Lunar Module pilots he should be first, but they responded cynically about what they perceived as a lobbying campaign. Attempting to stem interdepartmental conflict, Slayton told Aldrin that Armstrong would be first since he was the commander. The decision was announced in a press conference on April 14, 1969.<sup about="#mwt393" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEHansen2005363–365_93-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEHansen2005363–365&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005363–365-93&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hansen&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2005&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;363–365&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005363–365-93" id="mwA1g"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA1k"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA1o">[</span>92<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA1s">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwA1w">For decades, Aldrin believed the final decision was largely driven by the Lunar Module's hatch location. Because the astronauts had their spacesuits on and the spacecraft was so small, maneuvering to exit the spacecraft was difficult. The crew tried a simulation in which Aldrin left the spacecraft first, but he damaged the simulator while attempting to egress. While this was enough for mission planners to make their decision, Aldrin and Armstrong were left in the dark on the decision until late spring.<sup about="#mwt396" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994149_94-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEChaikin1994149&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994149-94&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Chaikin&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;149&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994149-94" id="mwA10"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA14"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA18">[</span>93<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA2A">]</span></span></a></sup> Slayton told Armstrong the plan was to have him leave the spacecraft first, if he agreed. Armstrong said, "Yes, that's the way to do it."<sup about="#mwt399" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994150_95-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEChaikin1994150&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994150-95&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Chaikin&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1994&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;150&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEChaikin1994150-95" id="mwA2E"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA2I"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA2M">[</span>94<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA2Q">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwA2U">The media accused Armstrong of exercising his commander's prerogative to exit the spacecraft first.<sup about="#mwt402" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTESchefter1999281_96-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTESchefter1999281&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTESchefter1999281-96&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Schefter&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1999&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;281&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTESchefter1999281-96" id="mwA2Y"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA2c"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA2g">[</span>95<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA2k">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chris_Kraft" title="Chris Kraft" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA2o">Chris Kraft</a> revealed in his 2001 autobiography that a meeting occurred between Gilruth, Slayton, Low, and himself to make sure Aldrin would not be the first to walk on the Moon. They argued that the first person to walk on the Moon should be like <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Lindbergh" title="Charles Lindbergh" id="mwA2s">Charles Lindbergh</a>, a calm and quiet person. They made the decision to change the flight plan so the commander was the first to egress from the spacecraft.<sup about="#mwt405" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEHansen2005371–372_97-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEHansen2005371–372&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005371–372-97&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hansen&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2005&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;371–372&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHansen2005371–372-97" id="mwA2w"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA20"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA24">[</span>96<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA28">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section><section data-mw-section-id="15" id="mwA3A" aria-labelledby="Pre-launch"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Pre-launch">Pre-launch</h3></div>

<figure class="mw-default-size mw-halign-left" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwA3E"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:69-HC-620_-_SA506.jpg" class="mw-file-description" id="mwA3I"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:69-HC-620_-_SA506.jpg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f8/Apollo_11_Saturn_V_SN_SA506_%2869-HC-620%29.jpg/330px-Apollo_11_Saturn_V_SN_SA506_%2869-HC-620%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f8/Apollo_11_Saturn_V_SN_SA506_%2869-HC-620%29.jpg/960px-Apollo_11_Saturn_V_SN_SA506_%2869-HC-620%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="1200" data-file-height="917" data-file-type="bitmap" height="252" width="330" class="mw-file-element mw-file-upright" style="--mw-file-upright: 1.3" id="mwA3M"></a><figcaption id="mwA3Q">Saturn V SA-506, the rocket carrying the Apollo 11 spacecraft, moves out of the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_Assembly_Building" title="Vehicle Assembly Building" id="mwA3U">Vehicle Assembly Building</a> towards <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Launch_Complex_39" title="Launch Complex 39" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA3Y">Launch Complex 39</a>.</figcaption></figure>

<p id="mwA3c">The ascent stage of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_Module_Eagle" title="Lunar Module Eagle" id="mwA3g">LM-5 <i id="mwA3k">Eagle</i></a> arrived at the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kennedy_Space_Center" title="Kennedy Space Center" id="mwA3o">Kennedy Space Center</a> on January 8, 1969, followed by the descent stage four days later, and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Command_module_Columbia" title="Command module Columbia" id="mwA3s">CSM-107 <i id="mwA3w">Columbia</i></a> on January 23.<sup about="#mwt413" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Mission_Overview_6-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Mission Overview&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-Mission_Overview-6&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Mission_Overview-6" id="mwA30"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA34"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA38">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA4A">]</span></span></a></sup> There were several differences between <i id="mwA4E">Eagle</i> and Apollo 10's LM-4 <i id="mwA4I">Snoopy</i>; <i id="mwA4M">Eagle</i> had a VHF radio antenna to facilitate communication with the astronauts during their EVA on the lunar surface; a lighter ascent engine; more thermal protection on the landing gear; and a package of scientific experiments known as the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Early_Apollo_Scientific_Experiments_Package" title="Early Apollo Scientific Experiments Package" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA4Q">Early Apollo Scientific Experiments Package</a> (EASEP). The only change in the configuration of the command module was the removal of some insulation from the forward hatch.<sup about="#mwt408" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978472_98-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978472&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978472-98&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;472&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978472-98" id="mwA4U"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA4Y"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA4c">[</span>97<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA4g">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt416" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-99" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-99&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-99" id="mwA4k"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA4o"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA4s">[</span>98<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA4w">]</span></span></a></sup> The CSM was mated on January 29, and moved from the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operations_and_Checkout_Building" title="Operations and Checkout Building" id="mwA40">Operations and Checkout Building</a> to the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_Assembly_Building" title="Vehicle Assembly Building" id="mwA44">Vehicle Assembly Building</a> on April 14.<sup about="#mwt417" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Mission_Overview_6-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Mission Overview&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Mission_Overview-6" id="mwA48"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA5A"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA5E">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA5I">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwA5M">The <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S-IVB" title="S-IVB" id="mwA5Q">S-IVB</a> third stage of Saturn V AS-506 had arrived on January 18, followed by the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S-II" title="S-II" id="mwA5U">S-II</a> second stage on February 6, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S-IC" title="S-IC" id="mwA5Y">S-IC</a> first stage on February 20, and the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturn_V_Instrument_Unit" title="Saturn V Instrument Unit" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA5c">Saturn V Instrument Unit</a> on February 27. At 12:30 on May 20, the <span about="#mwt418" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwA5g" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;5443&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;t&quot;},&quot;adj&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;on&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">5,443-tonne (5,357-long-ton; 6,000-short-ton)</span> assembly departed the Vehicle Assembly Building atop the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crawler-transporter" title="Crawler-transporter" id="mwA5k">crawler-transporter</a>, bound for Launch Pad 39A, part of <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Launch_Complex_39" title="Launch Complex 39" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA5o">Launch Complex 39</a>, while Apollo 10 was still on its way to the Moon. A countdown test commenced on June 26, and concluded on July 2. The launch complex was floodlit on the night of July 15, when the crawler-transporter carried the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Service_structure" title="Service structure" id="mwA5s">mobile service structure</a> back to its parking area.<sup about="#mwt428" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Mission_Overview_6-3" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Mission Overview&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Mission_Overview-6" id="mwA5w"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA50"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA54">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA58">]</span></span></a></sup> In the early hours of the morning, the fuel tanks of the S-II and S-IVB stages were filled with <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liquid_hydrogen" title="Liquid hydrogen" id="mwA6A">liquid hydrogen</a>.<sup about="#mwt419" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474_100-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;474&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100" id="mwA6E"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA6I"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA6M">[</span>99<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA6Q">]</span></span></a></sup> Fueling was completed by three hours before launch.<sup about="#mwt422" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475_101-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475-101&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;475&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475-101" id="mwA6U"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA6Y"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA6c">[</span>100<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA6g">]</span></span></a></sup> Launch operations were partly automated, with 43 programs written in the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ATOLL_(programming_language)" title="ATOLL (programming language)" id="mwA6k">ATOLL programming language</a>.<sup about="#mwt425" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978355–356_102-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978355–356&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978355–356-102&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;355–356&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978355–356-102" id="mwA6o"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA6s"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA6w">[</span>101<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA60">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwA64">Slayton roused the crew shortly after 04:00, and they showered, shaved, and had the traditional pre-flight breakfast of steak and eggs with Slayton and the backup crew. They then donned their space suits and began breathing pure oxygen. At 06:30, they headed out to Launch Complex 39.<sup about="#mwt429" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001355–357_103-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001355–357&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001355–357-103&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;355–357&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001355–357-103" id="mwA68"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA7A"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA7E">[</span>102<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA7I">]</span></span></a></sup> Haise entered <i id="mwA7M">Columbia</i> about three hours and ten minutes before launch time. Along with a technician, he helped Armstrong into the left-hand couch at 06:54. Five minutes later, Collins joined him, taking up his position on the right-hand couch. Finally, Aldrin entered, taking the center couch.<sup about="#mwt432" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475_101-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475-101&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;475&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475-101" id="mwA7Q"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA7U"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA7Y">[</span>100<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA7c">]</span></span></a></sup> Haise left around two hours and ten minutes before launch.<sup about="#mwt443" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-AP11FJ_104-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;AP11FJ&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-AP11FJ-104&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-AP11FJ-104" id="mwA7g"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA7k"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA7o">[</span>103<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA7s">]</span></span></a></sup> The closeout crew sealed the hatch, and the cabin was purged and pressurized. The closeout crew then left the launch complex about an hour before launch time. The countdown became automated at three minutes and twenty seconds before launch time.<sup about="#mwt435" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475_101-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475-101&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;475&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978475-101" id="mwA7w"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA70"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA74">[</span>100<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA78">]</span></span></a></sup> Over 450 personnel were at the consoles in the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Firing_room" title="Firing room" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA8A">firing room</a>.<sup about="#mwt438" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474_100-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;474&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100" id="mwA8E"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA8I"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA8M">[</span>99<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA8Q">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

</section></section><section data-mw-section-id="16" id="mwA8U" aria-labelledby="Mission"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Mission">Mission</h2></div>
<section data-mw-section-id="17" id="mwA8Y" aria-labelledby="Launch_and_flight_to_lunar_orbit"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Launch_and_flight_to_lunar_orbit">Launch and flight to lunar orbit</h3></div>

<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwA8c"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_Launch_-_GPN-2000-000630.jpg" class="mw-file-description" id="mwA8g"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_Launch_-_GPN-2000-000630.jpg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/16/Apollo_11_Launch_-_GPN-2000-000630.jpg/250px-Apollo_11_Launch_-_GPN-2000-000630.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/16/Apollo_11_Launch_-_GPN-2000-000630.jpg/500px-Apollo_11_Launch_-_GPN-2000-000630.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" alt="" data-file-width="2400" data-file-height="3000" data-file-type="bitmap" height="313" width="250" class="mw-file-element" id="mwA8k"></a><figcaption id="mwA8o">The Apollo 11 Saturn V space vehicle lifts off with astronauts Neil A. Armstrong, Michael Collins and Edwin E. Aldrin Jr. at 9:32<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwA8s">&nbsp;</span>am. EDT July 16, 1969, from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39A.</figcaption></figure>

<p id="mwA8w">An estimated one million spectators watched the launch of Apollo 11 from the highways and beaches in the vicinity of the launch site. Dignitaries included the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chief_of_Staff_of_the_United_States_Army" title="Chief of Staff of the United States Army" id="mwA80">Chief of Staff of the United States Army</a>, <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_(United_States)" title="General (United States)" id="mwA84">General</a> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Westmoreland" title="William Westmoreland" id="mwA88">William Westmoreland</a>, four <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_the_United_States" title="Cabinet of the United States" id="mwA9A">cabinet members</a>, 19 <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(United_States)" title="Governor (United States)" id="mwA9E">state governors</a>, 40 <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayoralty_in_the_United_States" title="Mayoralty in the United States" id="mwA9I">mayors</a>, 60 ambassadors and 200 <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congressmen" title="Congressmen" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA9M">congressmen</a>. Vice President <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spiro_Agnew" title="Spiro Agnew" id="mwA9Q">Spiro Agnew</a> viewed the launch with former president <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lyndon_B._Johnson" title="Lyndon B. Johnson" id="mwA9U">Lyndon B. Johnson</a> and his wife <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Bird_Johnson" title="Lady Bird Johnson" id="mwA9Y">Lady Bird Johnson</a>.<sup about="#mwt444" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474_100-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;474&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100" id="mwA9c"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA9g"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA9k">[</span>99<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA9o">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt447" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370_105-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370-105&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Bilstein&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1980&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;369–370&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370-105" id="mwA9s"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA9w"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA90">[</span>104<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA94">]</span></span></a></sup> Around 3,500 media representatives were present.<sup about="#mwt450" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979338_106-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979338&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979338-106&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Brooks&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Grimwood&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Swenson&quot;},&quot;4&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1979&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;338&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBrooksGrimwoodSwenson1979338-106" id="mwA98"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA-A"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA-E">[</span>105<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA-I">]</span></span></a></sup> About two-thirds were from the United States; the rest came from 55 other countries. The launch was televised live in 33 countries, with an estimated 25<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwA-M">&nbsp;</span>million viewers in the United States alone. Millions more around the world listened to radio broadcasts.<sup about="#mwt453" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370_105-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370-105&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Bilstein&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1980&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;369–370&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBilstein1980369–370-105" id="mwA-Q"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA-U"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA-Y">[</span>104<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA-c">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt456" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474_100-3" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Benson&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Faherty&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1978&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;474&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBensonFaherty1978474-100" id="mwA-g"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA-k"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA-o">[</span>99<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA-s">]</span></span></a></sup> President <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Nixon" title="Richard Nixon" id="mwA-w">Richard Nixon</a> viewed the launch from his office in the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_House" title="White House" id="mwA-0">White House</a> with his NASA liaison officer, Apollo astronaut <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Borman" title="Frank Borman" id="mwA-4">Frank Borman</a>.<sup about="#mwt461" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-107" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-107&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-107" id="mwA-8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA_A"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA_E">[</span>106<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA_I">]</span></span></a></sup> Lodging near Cape Canaveral was reported as being booked months ahead in advance for the launch by a Florida newspaper.<sup about="#mwt464" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-108" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-108&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-108" id="mwA_M"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA_Q"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA_U">[</span>107<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA_Y">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwA_c">Saturn V AS-506 launched Apollo 11 on July 16, 1969, at 13:32:00 <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTC" title="UTC" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA_g">UTC</a> (9:32:00 <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Daylight_Time" title="Eastern Daylight Time" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA_k">EDT</a>).<sup about="#mwt468" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-Mission_Overview_6-4" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;Mission Overview&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-Mission_Overview-6" id="mwA_o"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwA_s"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA_w">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwA_0">]</span></span></a></sup> At 13.2 seconds into the flight, the vehicle began to <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roll_program" title="Roll program" id="mwA_4">roll</a> into its <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flight_azimuth" title="Flight azimuth" class="mw-redirect" id="mwA_8">flight azimuth</a> of 72.058°. Full shutdown of the first-stage engines occurred about 2<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwBAA">&nbsp;</span>minutes and 42 seconds into the mission, followed by separation of the S-IC and ignition of the S-II engines. The second stage engines then cut off and separated at about 9<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwBAE">&nbsp;</span>minutes and 8<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwBAI">&nbsp;</span>seconds, allowing the first ignition of the S-IVB engine a few seconds later.<sup about="#mwt465" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106_8-2" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Orloff&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;106&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8" id="mwBAM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBAQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBAU">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBAY">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBAc">Apollo 11 entered a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_orbit" title="Circular orbit" id="mwBAg">near-circular Earth orbit</a> at an altitude of <span about="#mwt469" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBAk" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;100.4&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;nmi&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;km&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">100.4 nautical miles (185.9</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt469">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt469">km)</span> by <span about="#mwt470" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBAo" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;98.9&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;nmi&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;km&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">98.9 nautical miles (183.2</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt470">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt470">km)</span>, twelve minutes into its flight. After one and a half orbits, which took around two and a half hours, a second ignition of the S-IVB engine pushed the spacecraft onto its trajectory toward the Moon with the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trans-lunar_injection" title="Trans-lunar injection" id="mwBAs">trans-lunar injection</a> (TLI) burn, which took about 5 minutes and 47 seconds and started at 16:16:16 UTC. About 30 minutes later, with Collins in the left seat and at the controls, the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transposition,_docking,_and_extraction" title="Transposition, docking, and extraction" id="mwBAw">transposition, docking, and extraction</a> maneuver was performed. This involved separating <i id="mwBA0">Columbia</i> from the spent S-IVB stage, turning around, and docking with <i id="mwBA4">Eagle</i> still attached to the stage. After the LM was extracted, the combined spacecraft headed for the Moon, while the rocket stage flew on a trajectory past the Moon.<sup about="#mwt471" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollins2001374–375_109-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTECollins2001374–375&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001374–375-109&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Collins&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2001&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;374–375&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollins2001374–375-109" id="mwBA8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBBA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBBE">[</span>108<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBBI">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt474" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106_8-3" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Orloff&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;106&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8" id="mwBBM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBBQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBBU">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBBY">]</span></span></a></sup> This was done to avoid the third stage colliding with the spacecraft, the Earth, or the Moon. A <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravity_assist" title="Gravity assist" id="mwBBc">slingshot effect</a> from passing around the Moon threw it into an <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heliocentric_orbit" title="Heliocentric orbit" id="mwBBg">orbit around the Sun</a>.<sup about="#mwt477" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEMarshall_Space_Flight_Center19697_110-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEMarshall Space Flight Center19697&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEMarshall_Space_Flight_Center19697-110&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Marshall Space Flight Center&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1969&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;7&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMarshall_Space_Flight_Center19697-110" id="mwBBk"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBBo"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBBs">[</span>109<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBBw">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBB0">On July 19 at 17:21:50 UTC, Apollo 11 passed behind the Moon and fired its service propulsion engine to enter <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_orbit" title="Lunar orbit" id="mwBB4">lunar orbit</a>.<sup about="#mwt480" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106_8-4" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Orloff&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;106&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8" id="mwBB8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBCA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCE">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCI">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt491" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-111" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-111&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-111" id="mwBCM"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBCQ"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCU">[</span>110<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBCY">]</span></span></a></sup> In the thirty orbits that followed, the crew saw passing views of their landing site in the southern Sea of Tranquility about <span about="#mwt483" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBCc" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;12&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;mi&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;km&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">12 miles (19</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt483">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt483">km)</span> southwest of the crater <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Collins_(crater)" title="Collins (crater)" id="mwBCg">Sabine D</a>. The site was selected in part because it had been characterized as relatively flat and smooth by the automated <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ranger_8" title="Ranger 8" id="mwBCk">Ranger 8</a> and <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveyor_5" title="Surveyor 5" id="mwBCo">Surveyor 5</a> landers and the Lunar Orbiter mapping spacecraft, and because it was unlikely to present major landing or EVA challenges.<sup about="#mwt494" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-112" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-112&quot;}}"><a href="#cite_note-112" id="mwBCs"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBCw"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBC0">[</span>111<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBC4">]</span></span></a></sup> It lay about <span about="#mwt484" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBC8" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;25&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;km&quot;},&quot;sp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;us&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">25 kilometers (16</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt484">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt484">mi)</span> southeast of the Surveyor<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwBDA">&nbsp;</span>5 landing site, and <span about="#mwt485" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBDE" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;68&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;km&quot;},&quot;sp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;us&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">68 kilometers (42</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt485">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt485">mi)</span> southwest of Ranger<span typeof="mw:Entity" id="mwBDI">&nbsp;</span>8's crash site.<sup about="#mwt486" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEMission_Evaluation_Team1969130_113-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEMission Evaluation Team1969130&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEMission_Evaluation_Team1969130-113&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Mission Evaluation Team&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1969&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;130&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a </section><section data-mw-section-id="18" id="mwBDc" aria-labelledby="Lunar_descent"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Lunar_descent">Lunar descent</h3></div>

<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb" id="mwBDg"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_CSM_photographed_from_Lunar_Module_(AS11-37-5445).jpg" class="mw-file-description" id="mwBDk"><img resource="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Apollo_11_CSM_photographed_from_Lunar_Module_(AS11-37-5445).jpg" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/25/Apollo_11_CSM_photographed_from_Lunar_Module_%28AS11-37-5445%29.jpg/330px-Apollo_11_CSM_photographed_from_Lunar_Module_%28AS11-37-5445%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/25/Apollo_11_CSM_photographed_from_Lunar_Module_%28AS11-37-5445%29.jpg/960px-Apollo_11_CSM_photographed_from_Lunar_Module_%28AS11-37-5445%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" alt="The top of the silvery command module is seen over a grey, cratered lunar surface" data-file-width="4112" data-file-height="4112" data-file-type="bitmap" height="300" width="300" class="mw-file-element mw-file-upright" style="--mw-file-upright: 1.2" id="mwBDo"></a><figcaption id="mwBDs"><a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Command_module_Columbia" title="Command module Columbia" id="mwBDw"><i id="mwBD0">Columbia</i></a> in lunar orbit, photographed from <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_Module_Eagle" title="Lunar Module Eagle" id="mwBD4"><i id="mwBD8">Eagle</i></a></figcaption></figure>

<p id="mwBEA">At 12:52:00 UTC on July 20, Aldrin and Armstrong entered <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunar_Module_Eagle" title="Lunar Module Eagle" id="mwBEE"><i id="mwBEI">Eagle</i></a>, and began the final preparations for lunar descent.<sup about="#mwt495" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106_8-5" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000106-8&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Orloff&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2000&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;106&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a id="mwBEY">]</span></span></a></sup> At 17:44:00 <i id="mwBEc">Eagle</i> separated from <i id="mwBEg">Columbia</i>.<sup about="#mwt498" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEOrloff2000107_13-1" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" id="mwBEw">]</span></span></a></sup> Collins, alone aboard <i id="mwBE0">Columbia</i>, inspected <i id="mwBE4">Eagle</i> as it pirouetted before him to ensure the craft was not damaged, and that the landing gear was correctly deployed.<sup about="#mwt501" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEMission_Evaluation_Team19699_114-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" id="mwBE8"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBFA"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFE">[</span>113<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFI">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt504" class="mw-ref id="mwBFY">]</span></span></a></sup> Armstrong exclaimed: "The <i id="mwBFc">Eagle</i> has wings!"<sup about="#mwt507" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollinsAldrin1975209_115-1" href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTECollinsAldrin1975209-115" id="mwBFg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBFk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBFo">[</span>114<span class="cite-bracket" <p id="mwBFw">As the descent began, Armstrong and Aldrin found themselves passing landmarks on the surface two or three seconds early, and reported that they were "long"; they would land miles west of their target point. <i id="mwBF0">Eagle</i> was traveling too fast. The problem could have been <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mass_concentration_(astronomy)" title="Mass concentration (astronomy)" id="mwBF4">mascons</a>—concen<span typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Entity" about="#mwt510" id="mwBF8" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;shy&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Shy&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">­</span>tra<span typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Entity" about="#mwt511" id="mwBGA" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;shy&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Shy&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">­</span>tions of high mass in a region or regions of the Moon's crust that contains a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravity_anomaly" title="Gravity anomaly" id="mwBGE">gravitational anomaly</a>, potentially altering <i id="mwBGI">Eagle</i><span class="nowrap" style="padding-left:0.1em;" about="#mwt512" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBGM" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;'s&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:'s&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><span typeof="mw:Entity">'</span>s</span> trajectory. Flight Director Gene Kranz speculated that it could have resulted from extra air pressure in the docking tunnel, or a result of <i id="mwBGQ">Eagle</i><span class="nowrap" style="padding-left:0.1em;" about="#mwt513" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBGU" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;'&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:'&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><span typeof="mw:Entity">'</span></span>s pirouette maneuver.<sup about="#mwt514" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEMindell2008220–221_116-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMindell2008220–221-116" id="mwBGY"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBGc"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBGg">[</span>115<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBGk">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt517" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEMission_Evaluation_Team196982_117-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion Evaluation Team&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;1969&quot;},&quot;p&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;82&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMission_Evaluation_Team196982-117" id="mwBGo"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBGs"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBGw">[</span>116<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBG0">]</span></span></a></sup></p>

<p id="mwBG4">Five minutes into the descent burn, and <span about="#mwt520" typeof="mw:Transclusion" id="mwBG8" data-mw="{&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;convert&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Convert&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;6000&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;ft&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;m&quot;},&quot;4&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;-2&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}">6,000 feet (1,800</span><span typeof="mw:Entity" about="#mwt520">&nbsp;</span><span about="#mwt520">m)</span> above the surface of the Moon, the <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_Guidance_Computer" title="Apollo Guidance Computer" id="mwBHA">LM guidance computer</a> (LGC) distracted the crew with the first of several unexpected 1201 and 1202 program alarms. Inside Mission Control Center, computer engineer <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jack_Garman" title="Jack Garman" id="mwBHE">Jack Garman</a> told <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flight_controller#GUIDO" title="Flight controller" id="mwBHI">Guidance Officer</a> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Bales" title="Steve Bales" id="mwBHM">Steve Bales</a> it was safe to continue the descent, and this was relayed to the crew. The program alarms indicated "executive overflows", meaning the guidance computer could not complete all its tasks in real-time and had to postpone some of them.<sup about="#mwt521" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTECollinsAldrin1975210–212_118-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" id="mwBHc">]</span></span></a></sup><sup about="#mwt524" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-FOOTNOTEHamiltonHackler200834–43_119-0" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Transclusion mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ref&quot;,&quot;attrs&quot;:{&quot;group&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;FOOTNOTEHamiltonHackler200834–43&quot;},&quot;body&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;mw-reference-text-cite_note-FOOTNOTEHamiltonHackler200834–43-119&quot;},&quot;parts&quot;:[{&quot;template&quot;:{&quot;target&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;sfn&quot;,&quot;href&quot;:&quot;./Template:Sfn&quot;},&quot;params&quot;:{&quot;1&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hamilton&quot;},&quot;2&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;Hackler&quot;},&quot;3&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;2008&quot;},&quot;pp&quot;:{&quot;wt&quot;:&quot;34–43&quot;}},&quot;i&quot;:0}}]}"><a href="#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHamiltonHackler200834–43-119" id="mwBHg"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwBHk"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBHo">[</span>118<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwBHs">]</span></span></a></sup> <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Margaret_Hamilton_(software_engineer)" title="Margaret Hamilton (software engineer)" id="mwBHw">Margaret
